items.summary: While the top- and bottom-line numbers for Mondelez (MDLZ) give a sense of how the business performed in the quarter ended June 2026, it could be worth looking at how some of its key metrics compare to Wall Street estimates and year-ago values.

items.title: Mondelez (MDLZ) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Top Estimates
items.summary: Mondelez (MDLZ) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +8.96% and +1.39%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Ford, Visa, Seagate: After-Hours Stocks to Watch
items.summary: ↗️ Ford Motor (F): The automaker lifted its outlook as it now expects prices to be slightly higher this year. Shares advanced 7% in after-hours trading. ↘️ Visa (V): The payments company recorded higher revenue, thanks in part to resilient spending among consumers and businesses.

items.title: Mondelez International Lifts Outlook on Higher Quarterly Sales
items.summary: The Latin America market drove strength in second-quarter sales, and the Oreo and Cadbury owner now expects at least 2% growth in organic net revenue. Shares rose after-hours.

items.title: Mondelez’s (NASDAQ:MDLZ) Q2 CY2026 Sales Beat Estimates
items.summary: Packaged snacks company Mondelez (NASDAQ:MDLZ) reported Q2 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 4.1% year on year to $9.36 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.73 per share was 7.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
